# Pricing restructure — remove 1-month packages

## Context
High churn on 1-month packages (80%). Need to push users toward longer commitments.

## Decision
Remove 1-month packages. Minimum is now 3 months.

## Rationale
- 1-month churn is 80% vs 45% for 3-month
- Revenue impact is minimal (1-month is only 12% of revenue)
- Reduces support burden
